name: Dragon-Torrents
description: A sleek, lightning-fast, and feature-rich WebUI for sharing and downloading torrent files within your community. Built with a beautiful dark-mode TailwindCSS interface and powered by an ultra-lightweight Nginx Alpine Docker container.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: De poort voor de webinterface. Als 8080 al in gebruik is, verander dit dan naar bijvoorbeeld 8081.
